bm_desc: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 and 44(3) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI LODR Regulations ) - Outcome of the 52nd Annual General Meeting of the Company and Disclosure of voting results thereat.
